title: osCommerce to WooCommerce: six weekends, no SEO loss
lede: A 14-year-old osCommerce store moved onto WooCommerce in six weekends. The URL map, the specials-to-sale-price bridge, and the SEO that kept its rankings.
hero_alt: Overhead photo of paper URL redirect map, manila folder, schedule, brass REDIRECTS plate, SEO sheets, red wax seal.
